<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="428" height="886" viewBox="0 0 428 886">
  <rect width="428" height="886" rx="40" fill="#F6F6F6"/>
  <rect x="8" y="8" width="412" height="870" rx="36" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="28" y=" thirty" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="30" x2="340" y2="30" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="27" x2="340" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

    <rect x="350" y="24" width="12" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="367" y="25" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="304" cy="28" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="294" y1="29" x2="299" y2="24" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="299" y1="24" x2="304" y2="29" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="291" y1="32" x2="304" y2="32" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="32,76 24,84 32,92" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="49" y="89" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Buat Postingan</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="333" y="68" width="61" height="31" rx="16" fill="#F6F6F6"/>
      <text x="363.5" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#8F8F8F">Batal</text>
    </g>
    <line x1="24" y1="112" x2="404" y2="112" stroke="#E8E6EA" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Author row -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="48" cy="140" r="23" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="48" y="148" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Syne, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">S</text>
    <text x="82" y="137" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Salsa Maharani</text>
    <text x="82" y="155" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">Bagikan sesuatu yang berarti</text>
    <rect x="310" y="130" width="84" height="25" rx="13" fill="#F6F6F6"/>
    <circle cx="325" cy="142" r="4" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="337" y="146" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Publik</text>
    <polyline points="383,140 387,144 391,140" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Thought prompt -->
  <g>
    <rect x="23" y="178" width="382" height="66" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="23" y="176" width="382" height="66" rx="16" fill="#FFF4F1"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="209" r="17" fill="#FD9DAA"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="207" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="207" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <polyline points="45,216 50,219 55,216" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="78" y="200" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#B9363B">PROMPT HARI INI</text>
    <text x="78" y="220" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Hal kecil apa yang membuatmu tersenyum?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Complete text field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="271" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Tulis sesuatu</text>
    <rect x="23" y="282" width="382" height="116" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E6EA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="39" y="311" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A5A5A5">Ceritakan apa yang sedang kamu pikirkan...</text>
    <text x="39" y="335" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A5A5A5">Bagikan cerita, inspirasi, atau kabar baikmu.</text>
    <text x="375" y="380" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">0 / 500</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Media upload -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="428" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Tambahkan media</text>
    <rect x="23" y="440" width="382" height="91" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity="0.07"/>
    <rect x="23" y="438" width="382" height="91" rx="16" fill="#F6F6F6" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="71" cy="483" r="23" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="71" y1="473" x2="71" y2="493" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="61" y1="483" x2="81" y2="483" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="108" y="478" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Unggah foto atau video</text>
    <text x="108" y="497" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">Format JPG, PNG, atau MP4 · Maks. 10 MB</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Media chips -->
  <g>
    <rect x="23" y="544" width="115" height="30" rx="15" fill="#FFF4F1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="559" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#B9363B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="557" r="1.5" fill="#B9363B"/>
    <text x="57" y="563" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#B9363B">Foto / Video</text>
    <rect x="147" y="544" width="96" height="30" rx="15" fill="#F6F6F6"/>
    <circle cx="166" cy="559" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="162,560 165,563 171,556" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="180" y="563" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#8F8F8F">Lokasi</text>
    <rect x="252" y="544" width="92" height="30" rx="15" fill="#F6F6F6"/>
    <circle cx="270" cy="559" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="284" y="563" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#8F8F8F">Perasaan</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Visibility section -->
  <g>
    <line x1="24" y1="595" x2="404" y2="595" stroke="#E8E6EA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="24" y="624" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Siapa yang dapat melihat?</text>
    <text x="24" y="644" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">Postingan ini akan muncul di komunitasmu.</text>
    <rect x="330" y="614" width="64" height="28" rx="14" fill="#441D39"/>
    <circle cx="380" cy="628" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="376" cy="626" r="2" fill="#441D39"/>
    <ellipse cx="376" cy="633" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#441D39"/>
    <text x="24" y="675" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Publik</text>
    <text x="70" y="675" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">• Semua anggota Cleo dapat melihat postingan ini</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Action buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="23" y="700" width="176" height="43" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="111" y="727" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Simpan draf</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="211" y="700" width="194" height="43" rx="22" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="298" y="727" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Kirim</text>
    <polyline points="333,719 339,725 350,713" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="8" y="770" width="412" height="108" rx="0" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="770" x2="404" y2="770" stroke="#E8E6EA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="52,801 62,793 72,801" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="56" y="800" width="12" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="62" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Beranda</text>
    <!-- Explore -->
    <circle cx="145" cy="801" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="151" y1="808" x2="157" y2="814" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="145" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Jelajah</text>
    <!-- Create active -->
    <circle cx="214" cy="801" r="17" fill="#FD9DAA"/>
    <line x1="214" y1="793" x2="214" y2="809" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="206" y1="801" x2="222" y2="801" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="214" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Posting</text>
    <!-- Notifications -->
    <circle cx="284" cy="797" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="276" y="798" width="16" height="14" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="294" cy="795" r="4" fill="#B9363B"/>
    <text x="284" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Notifikasi</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="362" cy="797" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="362" cy="808" rx="10" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="362" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Profil</text>
    <rect x="147" y="858" width="134" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
